svg.text: GHOSTED: Juno the barista, explore (Illustrator, 2026-11-26)
Illustrator Phase 1-2: local references, 10 rough thumbnails, 3 directions, one pick. Hand-drawn Bezier half outlines lifted to round bodies (Ricky sketch library); palette rows only.
REFERENCES (local only, the locked family; no web)
Kit v5 (hero)
Ricky v1
Ghostie v7
ATS-9000 v1
Auntie Dot v1
Brett v1
Brett v1 lineup at the game camera (x1.5): the whole family on grass
THUMBNAILS (10). Top: front, rough. Below: the same at the game camera (x3, 26 m, pitch 42, net yaw 5), at 1.0 x Kit.
1 hourglass, puff, bib apron
2 capsule + apron box (BMGD)
3 column, long apron, scarf
4 mug: hand on hip = handle
5 hourglass, space buns
6 teardrop, low bun
7 hourglass, all apricot
8 hourglass, red apron
9 capsule, waist apron, puff
10 column, cream top, puff
DIRECTIONS (3), developed: front, 3/4, back; then the game camera (x3): Juno left, Kit right (real v7 render)
A. THE HOURGLASS (pick)
Wide at the shoulders, pinched at the apron tie,
wide at the hem: an hourglass, new in the family
(Kit capsule, Ricky bell, Dot pear, Brett wedge).
A dark coffee-brown top carries the read on grass
and path; the apricot bib apron and a red tie, bow
and scrunchie are the cafe rows. Hair pulled back
into a high puff: a clean forehead, and a round
dark top that no one else has.
B. CAPSULE + APRON BOX (BMGD)
The hint as given: a capsule with a red apron box
on a light top. At the game camera it is Kit's
capsule with Brett's red on the front and white
sleeves: it reads as a Brett cousin.
C. COLUMN + HEAD SCARF
A tall slim column with a long apron, a red
head scarf knotted on top. Barista-true, but at
pitch 42 the scarf is a red cap over the face:
red top + brown body is Brett's split upside
down, and the column is near the ATS box.
